notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield as Pirates due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers four times.
Resolve the first three triggers, causing you to gain control of up to three other creatures and untap them.
Resolve the last trigger, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this during each of your turns to gain control of all creatures during your turn.
